mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level directly reduces equity discount rates by lowering the risk-free rate, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital becomes cheaper for corporate investment and buybacks.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month CPIAUCSL acceleration exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed policy tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) indicate robust consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1300 thousand units but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO > 102.0), rising FEDFUNDS signals imminent policy tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO > 102.0 but FEDFUNDS increases and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained INDPRO level above 102.0 indicates robust manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.0 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month UNRATE decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market overheating that triggers wage inflation and Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent HOUST > 1300 thousand units and RSAFS > 710000 million dollars indicate strong consumer spending and housing demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days through immediate earnings impact.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 710000 but 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained PAYEMS growth rate above 0.5% monthly signals strong labor market health that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
